name: setColorScheme
description: DEPRECATED — kept for ONE release for interface compatibility and scheduled for removal in the next release. The currently-served /v1/ guest (nexus_web main) still calls this route from its Settings · Appearance page, so removing it in the same build that serves that guest breaks the page; it stays accepted-but-deprecated until the per-client guest (resolveTheme + caller-localStorage) is the one being served. Behaviour is unchanged: set the profile's browser colour scheme via ThemeService::SetBrowserColorScheme (pref browser.theme.color_scheme2). Chrome's ColorChangeUpdater fires, the panel re-resolves chrome://theme/colors.css and re-posts nexus-theme, so the guest repaints without a reload. Returns {ok:true}. Takes effect immediately — no restart. New clients must use appearance.resolveTheme instead and own their colour state locally.

inputs.name: scheme
inputs.description: One of "system", "light", "dark". Anything else is rejected as invalid args.
